title: usage_events
description: T-057 D4 usage analytics (ISS-T057OPS-001). ONE row per answered POST /ask or GET /search request, written fire-and-forget by apps/api/src/usage. Deliberately content-free: it records THAT a call happened, never WHAT was asked or answered. There is NO query text, answer text, hit list, API key id/hash/secret, IP address, user agent or request id - `additionalProperties: false` makes any such field a validation failure, not a quiet extra. Only 2xx (outcome ok) and 5xx (outcome error) responses are recorded; 4xx (bad request, missing scope, no tree yet) are caller mistakes, not usage. No retention/TTL is declared: no DECISIONS entry covers usage-event retention, so none is invented here (open question for the Approver).

_id.description: Random UUID; no information about the request.

tenantId.description: From the verified API key only, never from the request.

day.description: UTC calendar day of `at` (YYYY-MM-DD) - the bucket GET /usage groups by.

latencyMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from request arrival to response finish.
